title: Joey Porter Sr. slams Ben Roethlisberger: 'He's not a good teammate'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Joey Porter Sr. slams Ben Roethlisberger: 'He's not a good teammate'
sources.description: Joey Porter Sr. did not hold back when discussing Ben Roethlisberger on Cameron Heyward's podcast, saying the quarterback was "not a good teammate."
